max_active.title: Maximum deals of this kind (not archived)
max_active.description: Upper bound on deals of this kind that are active or paused.

max_percent.title: Maximum percent off
max_percent.description: No deal of this kind may take more than this percentage off.

max_windows.title: Maximum weekly windows per deal
max_windows.description: Weekday/time windows a deal may declare (overnight windows count once).

default_class.title: Default stacking class
default_class.description: Class given to new deals of this kind (one of stacking.classes).

default_priority.title: Default priority
default_priority.description: Priority of new deals of this kind (higher first).
